name: Chained head icon
description: UI slot icon for the chained head. Composes `ss.proj.ball` via `use` so the slot shows the actual packed head-plate, replacing the old hand-drawn i_pendulum (grey line and ball). Rim keeps the original's steel.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin (the old i_pendulum_evo), derived rather than drawn again. Takes the ball's own evolved variant with it, so the slot shows the amber head the evolved weapon actually swings rather than the base brown one.
